description: This source file defines a concurrency utility `TestIsolationLock` actor for managing access synchronization and a `TestIsolation` enum providing functions for temporarily modifying environment variables and user defaults within an isolated context for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestIsolationLock
classes.description: An actor managing a lock to ensure exclusive access during test isolation, queuing waiters and releasing the lock safely.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires the lock, suspending if it is already held.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the lock and resumes the next waiting continuation if any.

methods.name: withIsolatedState
methods.description: Executes a closure with modified environment variables and user defaults, restoring previous states afterward.

methods.name: restoreUserDefaults
methods.description: Restores user defaults to previous values.

methods.name: restoreEnv
methods.description: Restores environment variables to previous values.

methods.name: withEnvValues
methods.description: Runs a closure with specific environment variables set temporarily.

methods.name: withUserDefaultsValues
methods.description: Runs a closure with specific user defaults set temporarily.

methods.name: tempConfigPath
methods.description: Generates a temporary file path for test configuration, using a UUID for uniqueness.
